question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

ABCD, AXUR, ATMF, APET, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First letter → No change
 
• Second letter → (4) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series. 
 
• Third letter → (8) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Fourth letter → (12) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​So,​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/711e65224827c43b25802ae221c118f3763dfaee13f23715de8f2bb6cf002a2d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**ALWH**".
